outputs.label: Weighted average 9-month salary, professor/associate/assistant professor (Yale, 2024-25, weighted by 9-month staff count)

assumptions: Source: SAL2024_IS, IPEDS 2024-25 Provisional release, academic year 2024-25; full-time nonmedical instructional staff.
Ranks included by ARANK codes 1 Professor, 2 Associate professor, 3 Assistant professor; code 7 (all ranks total), 4 Instructor, 5 Lecturer, 6 No academic rank excluded.

Rank averages are SA09MAT (average salary on 9-month contract, total) and weights are SA09MCT (instructional staff on 9-month contract, total), so the weight is the same 9-month population as the salary average.
Weighted mean = sum(rank average x rank 9-month count) / sum(rank 9-month count) across the three ranks, unweighted by anything else.
Equated 9-month salaries (SAEQ9AT) were not used; they are computed on a different staff base (SATOTLT, all 9-12 month staff) and would answer a different question.
Salary is base salary only (no supplements/overloads), unscaled source dollars.
Named institution Yale University, UNITID 130794; population filters are not applied because the institution is named.
